patch_resolves_note: The staged `patch.diff` applied cleanly to the ARVO workspace checkout. On the original PoC, the fixed build still reaches the selected literal/length-tree increment with `literal_tree_root_guard.tree_maxbitlen == literal_tree_length15_increment.bitlen_index == 15`, but the repaired helper now records `literal_tree_root_guard.blcount_slots == literal_tree_length15_increment.blcount_slots == 288`, so the required root predicate is genuine and the sink-side out-of-bounds relation is no longer satisfied.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-side statement that consumes the harness-selected gunzip bytes and installs them into the inflator context for subsequent gzip/deflate parsing.

Incorrect stack extent. `blcount` is declared with `MAX_BIT_LENGTH == 15`, so it has only 15 elements, but the helper later uses caller-supplied code lengths as direct indices and the literal/length tree built in this witness legitimately reaches the value 15. The fix enlarges `blcount` and adds an explicit `bitlen[bits] >= LWS_ARRAY_SIZE(blcount)` check before incrementing it.
AddressSanitizer crash site. The increment reads and writes one `unsigned int` past the `blcount` stack array when the attacker-controlled code length equals 15.

edges.evidence: Both the vulnerable original and the fixed original record `literal_tree_root_guard.tree_maxbitlen == literal_tree_length15_increment.bitlen_index == 15` for the selected literal/length-tree iteration.
